name: Infosys

Systems Engineer (SE).dsaDepth: Light–Moderate - online assessment then a technical + HR round
rounds: Online assessment (aptitude, verbal, logical reasoning, basic coding)
Technical interview (CS fundamentals, projects, DSA basics)

Specialist Programmer (SP).dsaDepth: Heavy - timed competitive-programming rounds (implementation-heavy DP/greedy/grid problems), then DSA and system-design interviews
rounds: HackWithInfy or direct SP test: Round 1 (about 3 hrs, 3 problems: easy/medium/hard, implementation-heavy DP and modular arithmetic); Round 2 (offline, 4 problems: greedy, grid DP, state-transition DP)
Interview: DSA (2 problems, medium–hard) plus a system-design question (e.g. "design WhatsApp notifications at a high level")
Some loops add a paper-coding phase and a soft-skills-under-pressure group coding session
extraTopics: Competitive-programming-style DP and greedy problems (implementation-heavy, not always standard LeetCode)
Staying composed while being interrupted during live coding

Power Programmer (PP).dsaDepth: Heavy - similar bar to SP with added emphasis on internal upskilling potential
rounds: Technical interview covering DSA, projects and system design
Power Programmer (PP).notes: Fewer public reports specifically on PP; treat as close to the SP process.
